def left_rotate(n, d):
    # Calculate the number of bits to rotate by considering modulo 32
    bit_size = 32
    d = d % bit_size
    
    # Perform rotation and mask to 32 bits
    result = (n << d) | (n >> (bit_size - d))
    return result & ((1 << bit_size) - 1)

# Test the function with provided data points
assert left_rotate(16, 2) == 64
